notes: v2.27.0 — Profiles, scan aur madad ki behtari: (1) Login / Sign up par password dikhane wala 👁 button. (2) Duplicate Videos scan mein scope: Auto — tamam profiles, ya Manual — sirf ek chuni hui profile ke pages. (3) Profile rows par 🔄 Re-Connect aur 🔌 Disconnect — Disconnect se sirf token jata hai; profile, pages aur history mehfooz rehti hai. (4) Logo / Bio editor ab wahin popup (modal) mein khulta hai, page ke neeche nahi dhoondna padta. (5) Profiles mein unified '+ Add Profile ▾' menu — do steps: Step 1 Link Add (record banta hai, profile Pending rehta hai), Step 2 Claim / Connect (owner ki manzoori — Connect with Meta ya Token se; Pages khud andar aa jate hain); Bulk Import bhi isi menu mein hai. (6) Nayi ❓ Help & Support screen — quick start, how-tos, FAQ aur troubleshooting. (7) Meta permissions ki safai: OAuth ab wohi 6 permissions mangta hai jo App Review mein bheji gayi hain (business_management hata di gayi hai) — profiles ko dobara Connect karne par token inhi scopes ke sath ayega.
